LanguageData.HE_Kemet.label: Kingdom of New Kemet
LanguageData.HE_Kemet.description: The colony ship Iteru came down beside a great river in a land of red sand, and its people did what their ancestors had done: they measured the flood, dug canals and built in stone. New Kemet is an old-fashioned kingdom of farmers, scribes and stonemasons, proud, patient and very hard to starve. They count the Hellenes as friends and trade with everyone who brings timber.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet.doctrine.label: chariot vanguard
LanguageData.HE_Kemet.doctrine.description: Kemet's attack opens with speed: the vanguard runs ahead as the chariots once did and is on the walls before the defenders are ready.
